items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Terminology 72:1
items.html: The level of AB of clothing and the level of SAG of coarseness are the anterior of AVI. And Abba is the secret of HaVaYaH filled with Yods, and Ima is Ehyeh filled with Yods, both of which in gematria are “Regel” [רגל, 233], and in gematria “Zachor” [זכור, 233]. See answer 35. (Page 897, Item 48).
